mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-11 (corpus gx). SPIRIT-RESERVATION FALSE FRIEND (addendum B): 'A Solid Plan reduces persistent buff spirit reservation' -> reservation_resource=spirit, reservation_percent; this is the poe2 Spirit RESERVATION POOL, explicitly NOT routed toward any spirit-guide surface (steward addendum-B binding). Geometry = ground_targeted_circle (arrows-onto-designated-zone), NOT totem/proxy: although minions deliver the arrows, the DOMINANT loop (7.2) is the player commanding a zone-strike at a chosen point every few seconds -- it reads as a placed AoE, not an autonomous minion army. Physical -> element-neutral. Tactician ascendancy 'banner/covering-fire' identity -> ZONE_CONTROL (the 14m zone-denial) + PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY (minion-commanded fire) via main-law 5 (R-M1). Support-existence note (C2 corpus): Tactician is the closest PoE2 has to a support kit but is self-buff/zone-strike, not party support -- mapped as the zone-nuke it functionally is in solo scope. eras 0.2-0.5 CONFIRMED.
